Why D'Genius Solutions

A Website Partner Connecting Development with Digital Growth

Many website projects separate strategy, design, development, SEO and maintenance across conflicting agencies. D'Genius Solutions coordinates these disciplines under one accountable team so your website is built from day one as an organic growth engine.

01

Strategy Before Visual Design

The sitemap, user intent, page hierarchy and conversion journeys are mapped and stress-tested before visual styling begins. Design supports business function rather than forcing function to fit layout templates.

02

Technology Selected by Need

We choose WordPress, Next.js, React, PHP or custom CMS strictly according to content velocity, integrations, security requirements and team workflows—never forcing your business into an ill-fitting proprietary stack.

03

Search & Schema Built-In

Semantic HTML5, canonical tags, Open Graph meta, XML sitemap readiness and Schema.org entity graphs are engineered into every template from day one—not bolted on as an afterthought after launch.

04

Complete In-House Workflow

UI/UX design, frontend engineering, backend development, SEO foundations, conversion tracking and post-launch maintenance operate under one roof with direct developer communication and zero outsourced finger-pointing.

05

100% Client Code Ownership

No lock-ins, proprietary licenses or encrypted themes. Your business owns all code repositories, database assets, hosting environments and design files completely upon handover.

06

Dependable AMC Stewardship

Our relationship continues long after launch. Proactive monitoring, security hardening, automated off-site backups and monthly developer hours protect your investment as your company grows.

Development Process

A Clear Process from Discovery to Launch and AMC

A structured, six-stage engineering methodology eliminates guesswork, prevents scope drift and guarantees alignment between design, code and search performance.

Phase 01

Discovery & Objectives

Stakeholder workshops, target audience persona mapping, competitor benchmarking, technical requirement scoping, integration audits and measurable conversion goal setting.

Phase 02

Sitemap & Search Planning

Information architecture (IA) structuring, keyword intent clustering, page hierarchy mapping, URL slug definition and internal linking strategy to establish strong organic search foundations.

Phase 03

UI/UX & Content Flow

Wireframing, user journey design, responsive Figma prototypes, accessible typography systems, high-converting form layouts and collaborative client design reviews.

Phase 04

Development & Integrations

Clean semantic coding in WordPress, Next.js or custom PHP, modular component building, database structuring, CRM/ERP webhook connections and payment gateway setups.

Phase 05

QA, Performance & SEO Migration

Cross-browser matrix testing, mobile responsive QA, Core Web Vitals optimization, 1-to-1 301 redirect map execution, SSL verification and security vulnerability screening.

Phase 06

Launch, Measurement & AMC

Zero-downtime production deployment, Google Search Console & GA4 tracking configuration, team administrative training and seamless transition into proactive AMC care.

Website Redesign & Migration

Website Redesign and Zero-Downtime SEO Migration

A website revamp should elevate your brand and multiply conversions—never wipe out your hard-earned organic search rankings. We specialise in complex platform migrations with complete SEO equity preservation.

01

Comprehensive URL & Equity Audit

Before altering a single line of code, we crawl every indexed URL, map organic keyword rankings, assess historical backlink profiles and catalogue high-performing landing pages to protect existing equity.

02

Server-Level 301 Redirect Architecture

We engineer rigorous 1-to-1 301 permanent redirect maps directly at the server/Nginx level. This ensures search engine crawlers and users land on the exact corresponding page without redirect chains or 404 errors.

03

Database & Media Library Migration

Safe migration of WordPress posts, custom post types, historical lead submissions, user accounts and media libraries with automated path rewriting and WebP image optimization.

04

Staging Environment QA & Verification

Full testing in password-protected staging with noindex headers. We test form handlers, API hooks, responsiveness, third-party analytics and SSL certificate configurations before deployment.

05

Zero-Downtime Production Cutover

Atomic release switching ensures immediate site availability. Post-launch, we immediately submit fresh XML sitemaps to Google Search Console and monitor crawl frequency to guarantee index continuity.

Search & AI Readiness

SEO, AEO, GEO and LLM-Ready Website Development

Modern websites must perform across traditional search engines and next-generation generative AI answer engines. Every website we build is engineered for high visibility across Google, Bing, ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and Google AI Overviews.

Semantic Foundation

Semantic HTML5 & Crawl Architecture

Clean, accessible DOM structures with logical heading hierarchies (H1–H6), descriptive landmark elements, clean canonical paths and streamlined CSS/JS payloads that enable search engine bots and AI scrapers to parse content without friction.

Structured Data

Schema.org Entity Graph Coordination

Deep JSON-LD schema networks interconnected across Organization, WebSite, Service, LocalBusiness, FAQPage, BreadcrumbList and Article entities. This establishes verified topical authority and earns rich snippets in search results.

Answer Engines (AEO)

Answer Engine Optimization (AEO) Readiness

Content sections formatted specifically for Google AI Overviews and featured snippet extraction. Structured definitions, direct answer blocks, bulleted methodologies and transparent data tables optimized for quick retrieval.

Generative AI (GEO & LLMs)

LLM Brand Context & Knowledge Indexing

Authoritative brand positioning designed to inform large language model training sets and real-time retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) queries across Perplexity, ChatGPT Search, Microsoft Copilot and Claude.

Website Maintenance & AMC

Annual Maintenance Contracts for Long-Term Website Stability

Website AMC keeps your production website monitored, secure, backed up and constantly evolving with your business. Plans are tailored to your CMS, platform, traffic volume and update cadence.

01

Proactive Monitoring

Automated 24/7 uptime pings, SSL validity checks, broken link discovery and instant developer notifications to resolve technical hiccups before customers notice.

02

Security & Malware Defense

Regular vulnerability screening, web application firewall (WAF) rule tuning, brute-force protection and rapid remediation protocols in the event of an exploit.

03

Regular Core & Plugin Updates

Scheduled staging-tested updates for WordPress core, plugins, PHP runtime and npm dependencies to prevent version conflicts, layout breaks or security exposures.

04

Automated Cloud Backups

Daily or weekly automated encrypted off-site backups with comprehensive database dumps and file snapshots, ensuring 1-click disaster recovery readiness.

05

Performance Tuning

Ongoing database index optimization, cache policy recalibration, image compression sweeps and Core Web Vitals maintenance to keep page loading instantaneous.

06

Dedicated Technical Support

Direct monthly developer hours for new landing page creation, content revisions, banner updates, form modifications and third-party integration troubleshooting.
